entities.name: Robert I of Burgundy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Robert I, known as the Old or the Headstrong, was Duke of Burgundy from 1032 to his death. Robert was the third son of King Robert II of France and Constance of Arles. His brother was Henry I of France.
